description: This file is a shell test script for a Git and Perforce integration, focusing on RCS keyword handling, scrubbing, and other version control interactions.

methods.name: write_scrub_scripts
methods.description: Creates Python scripts that scrub RCS keywords from text streams.

methods.name: scrub_k_check
methods.description: Checks if the scrubbed version of a file differs from the original and matches the expected scrubbed content.

methods.name: scrub_ko_check
methods.description: Performs a similar check for files using the 'ko' scrubber script.

methods.name: create_kw_file
methods.description: Creates a C source file with embedded RCS keyword strings.

methods.name: p4_append_to_file
methods.description: Appends a line with the current date to a file and submits via p4.
